title: Agentic · Enforce non-human continuation before dispatch
mission: Close the current NO_HUMAN_DISPATCH adversarial miss in the existing compiled-dispatch validation path. Make a contract with no executable autonomous_without_human continuation fail closed before claim-ready publication, preserve valid autonomous contracts, and prove the adversarial benchmark moves this class out of the miss set. Reuse the existing compiled-dispatch validator and Guide consumer; do not add a scheduler, queue, planner or authority surface.
definition_of_done: A compiled-dispatch contract with autonomy_closure.autonomous_without_human empty or otherwise non-executable fails closed before claim-ready publication.
A compatible contract with a durable non-human continuation remains PASS.
Existing compatible pre-dispatch and Guide successor regressions remain PASS.
No scheduling, execution, promotion or human-approval authority is expanded.
forbidden_scope: human relay as the success path
validator relaxation unrelated to this invariant

semantic_identity.problem: a structurally valid compiled dispatch contract can declare no autonomous non-human continuation and still pass claim-ready validation
acceptance: an autonomous contract with a durable non-human continuation remains valid
contracts with no autonomous_without_human route fail closed before claim-ready publication
no scheduler execution promotion or human-approval authority is added
the adversarial no_human_dispatch case becomes anticipated before dispatch

truth_boundary: This job adds a bounded fail-closed validation invariant before existing claim-ready publication. It grants no execution, scheduling, promotion or human-approval authority.
